quote: Propranolol hydrochloride tablets, USP are indicated in the management of hypertension.
note: Essential hypertension is a subtype of the indicated hypertension.

quote: indicated in patients 12 years of age and older with WHIM syndrome (warts, hypogammaglobulinemia, infections and myelokathexis) to increase the number of circulating mature neutrophils
note: Myelokathexis is named as a component of WHIM and the stated effect (raising circulating neutrophils) addresses it directly.

quote: a discrete period of intense fear or discomfort in which four (or more) of the following symptoms develop
note: Discomfort appears only as a descriptive symptom of panic attacks; the indication is panic disorder, not discomfort.

quote: treats cold sores/fever blisters on the face or lips shortens healing time and duration of symptoms: tingling, pain, burning, and/or itching
note: Pain is only a symptom of cold sores being treated; lip pain generally is not an indication.
Indications are first aid for minor cuts, scrapes, burns; keratitis is not mentioned (eyes appear only as a do-not-use warning).

quote: indicated for the short term (up to 1 week) treatment of scurvy
note: Scurvy is named directly.

quote: Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura in adults Pure red cell aplasia Secondary thrombocytopenia in adults
note: Secondary (acquired) thrombocytopenia and ITP are listed indications.

quote: indicated for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus 1 (HIV 1) infection
note: Emtricitabine-containing combinations in EMA text are indicated for HIV-1 infection.

quote: treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic gastric, esophageal, or gastroesophageal junction cancer as a component of a combination chemotherapy regimen
note: Esophageal cancer is explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in patients who have a confirmed mutation of the DMD gene that is amenable to exon 53 skipping
note: DMD named directly (genetic subset).

quote: indicated for the treatment of seizures associated with Dravet syndrome (DS) in patients taking clobazam
note: Treating the seizures of an epilepsy syndrome is treating the syndrome.

quote: temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure
note: Sinus congestion is named as a use.

quote: Pheochromocytoma Propranolol hydrochloride tablets, USP are indicated as an adjunct to alpha-adrenergic blockade to control blood pressure and reduce symptoms of catecholamine-secreting tumors
note: Pheochromocytoma is a labeled (adjunctive management) indication.

quote: indicated for the prevention of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
note: Text treats only the itching symptom of allergic conjunctivitis, not conjunctivitis itself.

quote: indicated for reducing signs and symptoms, inducing major clinical response, inhibiting the progression of structural damage, and improving physical function in patients with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis
note: RA named directly.

quote: indicated as adjunctive therapy for the treatment of primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures in patients with epilepsy 12 years of age and older
note: Primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures equal bilateral tonic-clonic seizures with generalized onset.

quote: indicated in the treatment of edema associated with congestive heart failure, cirrhosis of the liver and the nephrotic syndrome; steroid-induced edema, idiopathic edema
note: Edema named directly.

quote: Severe psoriasis Severe seborrheic dermatitis
note: Severe seborrheic dermatitis is a listed dermatologic indication.
Only non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is indicated; small cell lung carcinoma is a different disease (substring collision).

quote: Primary hypogonadism (congenital or acquired) ( 1 ) • Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (congenital or acquired) ( 1 )
note: Hypogonadism forms are listed indications for testosterone replacement.

quote: Mycosis fungoides Severe psoriasis Severe seborrheic dermatitis
note: Severe psoriasis is a listed dermatologic indication.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with follicular lymphoma who relapsed after, or are refractory to, a rituximab-containing regimen
note: Follicular lymphoma named directly.

quote: Aspiration pneumonitis Asthma Fulminating or disseminated pulmonary tuberculosis when used concurrently with appropriate chemotherapy Hypersensitivity pneumonitis
note: Specific pneumonitis types are listed; pneumonitis is a near parent.

quote: indicated for the treatment of acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections (ABSSSI)
note: ABSSSI named directly.

quote: Rifampin is indicated in the treatment of all forms of tuberculosis.
note: Cutaneous TB is a form of tuberculosis.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients 2 years of age and older with active polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis
note: Polyarticular JIA is indicated; JIA is a near parent.

quote: Diffuse posterior uveitis and choroiditis
note: Choroiditis is listed among ophthalmic indications.

quote: indicated for the treatment of ocular inflammation and pain following ophthalmic surgery
note: Ocular (eye) pain is a treated target, postoperative setting.
Diphenhydramine texts cover topical pain/itching from burns, bites, rashes; nausea not mentioned.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL)
note: Only CLL/SLL is indicated; 'lymphoma' as a whole class is overbroad.

quote: Bylvay is indicated for the treatment of progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis (PFIC)
note: PFIC named directly (EMA).

quote: treatment of disease-related splenomegaly or symptoms in adult patients with primary myelofibrosis, post polycythaemia vera myelofibrosis
note: Post-PV myelofibrosis named; disease-related splenomegaly/symptoms is its management.

quote: Intramuscular corticosteroid preparations are contraindicated for idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura.
note: Immune/autoimmune thrombocytopenia appears only in contraindications; indications list only select secondary thrombocytopenia.

quote: reduce Total-C, LDL-C and ApoB levels in children and adolescents 8 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
note: HeFH named directly.
Text is opium tincture for diarrhea; infusion site pain not mentioned.

quote: long-term treatment of paediatric patients with growth disturbance due to insufficient secretion of growth hormone
note: GH replacement for insufficient GH secretion targets the GH deficiency itself.
Indications list various bacterial infections; Mycobacterium fortuitum is not mentioned.
